rationale: Moments handed to the 6DOF block about the BFRP (35 % MAC) instead of the CG (25 % MAC): the r_cg x F transfer is dropped, the trim no longer balances in pitch.
The 6DOF block's mass differs from the mass the weight and the trim use: lift balances the weight but the block accelerates a different mass.
Input held one step late (the next piece's value instead of the piece containing the step): the doublet is shifted by dt against vital.sim.run.
Euler angles handed to the 6DOF block in the wrong order ([psi theta phi] instead of [phi theta psi]): the aircraft starts banked 45 deg.
Weight pointing up in NED (z is down): the net force at the trim is twice the weight.
The logged alpha is wired to the sideslip output of the Incidence, Sideslip & Airspeed block: the plotted alpha is beta.
The 6DOF block gets a hand-simplified inertia (Ixz dropped) instead of the NASA F16_inertia.dml tensor.
